name: Jai Herbert
event: UFC Fight Night: Allen vs. Duncan
summary: A tall, rangy English striker and former Cage Warriors lightweight champion, now 38; ten knockout wins. Back in the win column with a first-round KO of Mandel Nallo in April.

how_they_fight.Striking: Long, straight punching from range; reach about 196 cm, big for lightweight.
how_they_fight.Grappling: Defends takedowns well (about 78%) but offers little offense on the mat.
how_they_fight.Defense: Decision losses when out-worked (Chris Padilla, Fares Ziam).
how_they_fight.Fight IQ: Experienced; must keep a wrestler at range.

sources.title: Matheus Camilo plans to respect Jai Herbert's experience at UFC Vegas 122
UFC Fight Night: Allen vs Duncan
